feedback.headline: Training has plateaued into a sub-optimal trash-clearing local optimum driven by NoOp collapse and spatial entropy skew, yielding 0.0% 3-star triples across 8,770 episodes.
feedback.progression_summary: Destruction percentage has stagnated from 56.65% in Phase 1 (episodes 1-1754) to 60.90% in Phase 5 (episodes 7017-8770), exhibiting a negligible full-run slope of +0.057% per 100 episodes. The 50-episode rolling average peaked at 65.5% at episode 6252 and has suffered a -6.0% drawdown to 59.46% in the recent 50 episodes (8721-8770), while the best single episode (90%) has not been matched in 4,959 episodes. Crucially, the 3-star triple rate remains at exactly 0.0% across all 8,770 episodes, and recent 2-star TH takedowns have dropped from a Phase 3 peak of 10.5% down to 4.0%.

what_is_going_wrong.title: Action Dump Pathology & Premature NoOp Collapse
what_is_going_wrong.symptom: NoOp frequency collapsed from 43.97% (episodes 1-50) to 0.11% (episodes 8721-8770); total episode steps halved from 64.5 to 36.3; hero abilities are dumped prematurely at simulation ticks 40-64, with all troops and spells exhausted by tick 320.
what_is_going_wrong.root_cause: The step reward shaping (+0.035 bonus for active non-NoOp steps vs. -0.04 penalty for NoOp while troops remain) combines with immediate fast-forward reward credit in finish_battle() to create an exploitable temporal shortcut. Under PPO discounting (gamma < 1.0), the policy maximizes immediate return by burning through all deployable assets as rapidly as possible to trigger finish_battle() and collect all destruction rewards instantly, completely disincentivizing tactical holding of spells and abilities.

what_is_going_wrong.title: Spatial Entropy Domination vs. Discrete Head Premature Convergence
what_is_going_wrong.symptom: Spatial pointer head (tile_xy) exhibits 101.2% saturated entropy (6.822) with top-5 tile mass of only 2.88% and wide deploy spread (sigma = 17.5 tiles), while slot_type entropy is collapsed to 31.2% (0.607) and slot_idx to 14.2% (0.326). Initial step slot_type is 97.5% Hero and deploy_fraction is 95.8% bin-1.
what_is_going_wrong.root_cause: A single scalar entropy coefficient (ent_coef = 0.015) is applied across the unweighted sum of factorized action heads. The 2,500-category spatial pointer head produces disproportionately large raw entropy (~6.8 nats), satisfying the PPO entropy bonus virtually on its own. This starves the low-cardinality discrete heads (slot_type, slot_idx, deploy_fraction) of exploration pressure, allowing them to freeze into rigid, deterministic deployment sequences while troops are scattered uniformly across the perimeter.

what_is_going_wrong.title: Perimeter Farming Local Optimum & Core Funneling Deficit
what_is_going_wrong.symptom: One-star rate reached 92.2% in Phase 5, but two-star rate (Town Hall takedown) dropped to 4.0% in recent 50 episodes, and three-star rate remains 0.0% across the entire run.
what_is_going_wrong.root_cause: Linear destruction rewards (0.5 pts per 1% up to 50 pts) provide an easily discoverable gradient for wide peripheral ring deployment, easily achieving the 50% destruction threshold (16.67 pts). Breaching the defended TH18 core requires tight spatial funneling and timed spell protection; premature core entry attempts without proper funneling result in swift army wipes and lower net destruction, trapping the policy in a perimeter-skimming local optimum.

what_is_going_wrong.title: Cross-Army Gradient Interference & High Value Estimation Variance
what_is_going_wrong.symptom: Thrower + Healer Smash averages 64.9% recent destruction vs. Dragon Duke Hydra at only 53.6% (11.3% performance split); critic suffers a -5.54 calibration gap between V(s0) (40.13) and empirical return (45.67).
what_is_going_wrong.root_cause: A rollout buffer of only batch_episodes = 4 across 3 radically different army archetypes and 5 village layouts provides high variance updates. Air hydra pathing requires tight lane funnels and late spell placement, which directly contradicts ground smash spread dynamics, creating conflicting policy gradients in the shared spatial stem and critic.

recommendations.action: Remove the +0.035 non-NoOp step bonus and -0.04 NoOp penalty; distribute fast-forwarded destruction deltas across simulated ticks rather than awarding full terminal credit to the final action step.
recommendations.target: Step reward shaping and finish_battle() credit assignment
recommendations.rationale: Eliminates the artificial incentive to spam all units and abilities in the first 30 seconds, restoring the value of NoOp (waiting) so the policy can learn to hold spells and hero abilities for core defense encounters.

recommendations.action: Decouple entropy regularization into normalized per-head coefficients: H_norm(a_i) = H(a_i) / log(|A_i|), with individual weights (e.g., ent_coef_spatial = 0.001, ent_coef_type = 0.03, ent_coef_idx = 0.03).
recommendations.rationale: Forces the spatial pointer to concentrate probability mass onto specific tactical funneling vectors while preventing slot_type and slot_idx from prematurely collapsing into rigid deterministic choices.

recommendations.action: Introduce a dedicated dense reward milestone for Town Hall 18 damage and destruction (+25 pts for TH takedown, separate from peripheral percentage).
recommendations.rationale: Directly reshapes the credit landscape to penalize 55% zero-TH perimeter attacks and overcome the deceptive reward valley between perimeter trash-clearing and core penetration.

recommendations.action: Increase batch_episodes from 4 to 32 (or 64) and introduce FiLM or gated cross-attention conditioning from the 64-D army inventory into the spatial stem.
recommendations.target: Rollout batch size and army context fusion architecture
recommendations.rationale: Reduces inter-episode gradient variance across base/army pairings and prevents ground smash tactical weights from degrading air hydra deployment policies.

Policy reliably clears perimeter trash buildings for 1★ (>50% destruction) but rarely funnels concentrated power into the Town Hall 18 core.
